title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

questions.sentence: Assalam alaikum, aap kaise hain?
options: Walaikum assalam, main theek hoon.
Main abhi ghar jaa raha hoon.
Mujhe aap ka naam maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Walaikum assalam, main theek hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Peace be upon you too, I am fine.

questions.sentence: Main theek hoon, shukriya.
options: I am fine, thank you.
I am not well today.
I am going home, thank you.
questions.correctAnswer: I am fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Kya aap theek hain?
options: Ji haan, main bilkul theek hoon.
Ji nahin, mujhe maloom nahin hai.
Ji haan, mera ghar yahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, main bilkul theek hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am completely fine.

questions.sentence: Tum kaise ho, dost?
options: How are you, my friend?
Where are you, my friend?
Who is your friend?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you, my friend?

questions.sentence: Salam, aap ka kya haal hai?
options: Sab theek hai, shukriya.
Mujhe abhi chai chahiye.
Main Lucknow mein rehta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Sab theek hai, shukriya.
questions.translatedSentence: Everything is fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Aur aap ka kya haal hai?
options: And how are you doing?
And where are you going?
And what is your name?
questions.correctAnswer: And how are you doing?

questions.sentence: Main aaj theek nahin hoon.
options: Kya hua, sab theek hai?
Bohat khoob, mubarak ho.
Ji haan, main bhi ghar jaa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Kya hua, sab theek hai?
questions.translatedSentence: What happened, is everything all right?

questions.sentence: Hum sab yahan theek hain.
options: We are all fine here.
They are all fine here.
You are all here with us.
questions.correctAnswer: We are all fine here.

questions.sentence: Aap ke ghar walay kaise hain?
options: Woh sab theek hain, shukriya.
Woh log abhi Karachi mein hain.
Mujhe unka naam maloom nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Woh sab theek hain, shukriya.
questions.translatedSentence: They are all well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Subah bakhair, aap ne chai pi?
options: Ji haan, abhi abhi pi hai.
Ji nahin, shab bakhair.
Ji haan, main raat ko so gaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, abhi abhi pi hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have just had some.

questions.sentence: Subah bakhair, aap jaldi uth gaye.
options: Good morning, you got up early.
Good night, you went to bed early.
Good morning, you have come late.
questions.correctAnswer: Good morning, you got up early.

questions.sentence: Tashreef laiye, yeh aap hi ka ghar hai.
options: Shukriya, aap bohat meherban hain.
Maaf kijiye, main ghar par nahin hoon.
Mujhe aap ka ghar maloom nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Shukriya, aap bohat meherban hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, that is very kind of you.

questions.sentence: Khush aamdeed, andar tashreef laiye.
options: Welcome, please come inside.
Welcome, please wait outside.
Goodbye, please come again.
questions.correctAnswer: Welcome, please come inside.

questions.sentence: Shab bakhair, main ab so raha hoon.
options: Shab bakhair, achhi neend aaye.
Subah bakhair, chai taiyar hai.
Khush aamdeed, andar aa jaiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Shab bakhair, achhi neend aaye.
questions.translatedSentence: Good night, sleep well.

questions.sentence: Raat bohat ho gayi hai, ab aaram kijiye.
options: It is very late, please rest now.
It is still early, please wait here.
It is very late, please come inside.
questions.correctAnswer: It is very late, please rest now.

questions.sentence: Aap ke liye chai laoon?
options: Ji haan, bari meherbani ho gi.
Ji nahin, shab bakhair aur khuda hafiz.
Ji haan, main chai nahin banata.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, bari meherbani ho gi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, that would be very kind of you.

questions.sentence: Hamare ghar mein aap ka khush aamdeed hai.
options: You are always welcome in our home.
We are always welcome in your home.
You are waiting outside our home.
questions.correctAnswer: You are always welcome in our home.

questions.sentence: Subah subah kahan jaa rahe hain?
options: Main kaam par jaa raha hoon.
Main raat ko ghar aaya tha.
Mujhe subah ka waqt maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Main kaam par jaa raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am on my way to work.

questions.sentence: Aap ki madad ka bohat shukriya.
options: Koi baat nahin, yeh mera farz tha.
Ji nahin, mujhe maloom nahin tha.
Meherbani kar ke thoda intezar kijiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahin, yeh mera farz tha.
questions.translatedSentence: Not at all, it was the least I could do.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, mujhe thodi der ho gayi.
options: I am sorry, I am a little late.
Excuse me, I have to leave now.
Thank you, I will come a little later.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, I am a little late.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, main aap ka waqt le raha hoon.
options: Koi harj nahin, aaram se boliye.
Ji haan, mujhe abhi jaana hai.
Shukriya, main bilkul theek hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi harj nahin, aaram se boliye.
questions.translatedSentence: No trouble at all, please take your time.

questions.sentence: Meherbani kar ke zara darwaza khol dijiye.
options: Please open the door for a moment.
Please close the window for a moment.
Please wait by the door for a moment.
questions.correctAnswer: Please open the door for a moment.

questions.sentence: Zara suniye, yeh raasta Charminar jaata hai?
options: Ji haan, seedha chalte rahiye.
Ji nahin, mujhe raasta maloom hai.
Shukriya, main wahan nahin jaata.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, seedha chalte rahiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, just keep going straight.

questions.sentence: Aap ki meherbani, main yeh kabhi nahin bhoolunga.
options: Thank you for your kindness, I will never forget it.
Forgive my mistake, I will never do it again.
With your permission, I will never come back here.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you for your kindness, I will never forget it.

questions.sentence: Mujh se ghalti ho gayi, maaf kar dijiye.
options: Koi baat nahin, insan se ghalti hoti hai.
Ji haan, mujhe bohat khushi hui.
Meherbani kar ke andar tashreef laiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahin, insan se ghalti hoti hai.
questions.translatedSentence: It is all right, everyone makes mistakes.

questions.sentence: Zara maaf kijiye, mujhe aage jaana hai.
options: Excuse me, I need to get past.
I am sorry, I have to go back.
Excuse me, do you need any help?
questions.correctAnswer: Excuse me, I need to get past.

questions.sentence: Aap ne mere liye itna kuch kiya, shukriya.
options: Iss mein shukriye ki kya baat hai.
Mujhe iss baat ka bohat afsos hai.
Main aap ko theek se nahin janta.
questions.correctAnswer: Iss mein shukriye ki kya baat hai.
questions.translatedSentence: There is no need to thank me for that.

questions.sentence: Achha, ab main chalta hoon.
options: Khuda hafiz, apna khayal rakhiye.
Khush aamdeed, andar tashreef laiye.
Koi baat nahin, main intezar kar raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Khuda hafiz, apna khayal rakhiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Goodbye, take care of yourself.

questions.sentence: Khuda hafiz, phir milte hain.
options: Goodbye, see you again.
Welcome, come again soon.
Good night, sleep well.
questions.correctAnswer: Goodbye, see you again.

questions.sentence: Kal phir mulaqat ho gi?
options: Ji haan, kal shaam ko zaroor.
Ji nahin, mujhe kal maloom nahin.
Ji haan, main kal Delhi se aaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, kal shaam ko zaroor.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, tomorrow evening for sure.

questions.sentence: Apna khayal rakhna aur waqt par khana khana.
options: Take care of yourself and eat on time.
Take care of yourself and sleep on time.
Look after the house and cook the food on time.
questions.correctAnswer: Take care of yourself and eat on time.

questions.sentence: Main ab Karachi wapas jaa raha hoon.
options: Safar achha guzre, khuda hafiz.
Bohat achha, andar tashreef laiye.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe yeh maloom nahin tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Safar achha guzre, khuda hafiz.
questions.translatedSentence: Have a good journey, goodbye.

questions.sentence: Phir milenge, jaldi wapas aaiyega.
options: We will meet again, please come back soon.
We met before, and you left very soon.
See you tomorrow, please do not be late.
questions.correctAnswer: We will meet again, please come back soon.

questions.sentence: Jaate jaate chai to pi kar jaiye.
options: Nahin shukriya, ab bohat der ho gayi hai.
Ji haan, mujhe chai raaste mein mil gayi thi.
Maaf kijiye, main chai nahin banata.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin shukriya, ab bohat der ho gayi hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No thank you, it is already very late.

questions.sentence: Ghar pohnch kar mujhe zaroor bataiyega.
options: Do let me know once you reach home.
Do call me before you leave home.
Please tell me where your home is.
questions.correctAnswer: Do let me know once you reach home.

questions.sentence: Aap se mil kar bohat khushi hui.
options: Mujhe bhi, phir mulaqat ho gi.
Mujhe iss baat ka afsos hai.
Main kab se aap ka intezar kar raha tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi, phir mulaqat ho gi.
questions.translatedSentence: Likewise, we will meet again.

questions.sentence: Bete, buzurgon se hamesha aap kah kar baat karo.
options: Ji, main yeh baat hamesha yaad rakhunga.
Ji nahin, main sab se tum kah kar baat karta hoon.
Ji, mujhe unka naam maloom nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji, main yeh baat hamesha yaad rakhunga.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will always remember that.

questions.sentence: Buzurgon ki izzat karna hamari tehzeeb hai.
options: Respecting our elders is part of our culture.
Respecting our elders is a very difficult duty.
Our elders taught us this old story.
questions.correctAnswer: Respecting our elders is part of our culture.

questions.sentence: Chacha jaan, aap yahan tashreef rakhiye.
options: Shukriya bete, tum bohat tameez daar ho.
Nahin, main abhi ghar wapas jaa raha hoon.
Maaf kijiye, main aap ko nahin janta.
questions.correctAnswer: Shukriya bete, tum bohat tameez daar ho.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, son, you are very well mannered.

questions.sentence: Agar aap ki ijazat ho to main baith jaoon?
options: May I sit down, if you permit?
May I leave now, if you permit?
Should I stand up because you have come?
questions.correctAnswer: May I sit down, if you permit?

questions.sentence: Kya main andar aa sakta hoon?
options: Ji zaroor, tashreef laiye.
Ji nahin, main abhi bahar hoon.
Shukriya, main andar aa gaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji zaroor, tashreef laiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, please come in.

questions.sentence: Apne se bade se hum tum kah kar baat nahin karte.
options: We do not address someone older than us as tum.
We should not speak to older people at all.
Older people always speak to us politely.
questions.correctAnswer: We do not address someone older than us as tum.

questions.sentence: Aap ne mujhe aap kah kar bulaya, main to chota hoon.
options: Adab har umar ke liye hota hai.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe maloom nahin tha.
Ji nahin, main aap se bada hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Adab har umar ke liye hota hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Good manners are meant for every age.

questions.sentence: Meherbani kar ke unhein khala jaan kahiye, naam se nahin.
options: Please call her khala jaan, not by her name.
Please tell her your name, not mine.
Please do not call her, she is resting.
questions.correctAnswer: Please call her khala jaan, not by her name.

questions.sentence: Mushaire mein pohnch kar sab se pehle kya karte hain?
options: Sab ko adab kah kar salam karte hain.
Seedha apni nazm sunane lagte hain.
Chup chaap baith kar chai peete hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Sab ko adab kah kar salam karte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: You greet everyone with adab first.

questions.sentence: Arre, aap se to barson baad mulaqat ho rahi hai!
options: Ji haan, waqt kitni jaldi guzar jaata hai.
Ji nahin, main kal hi aap se mila tha.
Maaf kijiye, main abhi jaldi mein hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, waqt kitni jaldi guzar jaata hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, how quickly the years go by.

questions.sentence: Bohat arse baad mile hain, lekin aap bilkul nahin badle.
options: We are meeting after a long time, but you have not changed at all.
We met a long time ago, and you have changed completely.
It has been a long time, so you must have forgotten me.
questions.correctAnswer: We are meeting after a long time, but you have not changed at all.

questions.sentence: Aaj kal aap kya kar rahe hain?
options: Main Hyderabad mein parhata hoon, aur aap?
Main kal Hyderabad jaa raha tha, aur aap?
Mujhe aaj kal ke baare mein kuch maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Hyderabad mein parhata hoon, aur aap?
questions.translatedSentence: I teach in Hyderabad these days, and you?

questions.sentence: Main Lucknow chhod kar Karachi aa gaya kyunki wahan kaam nahin tha.
options: I left Lucknow and came to Karachi because there was no work there.
I left Karachi for Lucknow although the work there was good.
I want to leave Karachi and go back to Lucknow for work.
questions.correctAnswer: I left Lucknow and came to Karachi because there was no work there.

questions.sentence: Ghar mein sab kaise hain, ammi ki tabiyat theek hai?
options: Sab theek hain, lekin ammi ki tabiyat thodi kharab hai.
Ji nahin, hamare ghar mein koi nahin rehta.
Ammi ne kal aap ko bohat yaad kiya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Sab theek hain, lekin ammi ki tabiyat thodi kharab hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone is well, but my mother is not keeping too well.

questions.sentence: Agar aap ko waqt ho to chai peete hain aur purani baatein karte hain.
options: If you have time, let us have tea and talk about old times.
When you have time, come home and eat something with us.
I have no time today, but we can talk about it tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have time, let us have tea and talk about old times.

questions.sentence: Aap ko yaad hai, hum saath mein nihari khane jaate the?
options: Bhoola kaise sakta hoon, woh din bohat achhe the.
Ji nahin, mujhe nihari bilkul pasand nahin hai.
Ji haan, main abhi nihari kha kar aaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Bhoola kaise sakta hoon, woh din bohat achhe the.
questions.translatedSentence: How could I forget, those were wonderful days.

questions.sentence: Eid par sheer khurma zaroor banta tha, lekin ab woh baat nahin rahi.
options: Sheer khurma was always made on Eid, but it is not the same any more.
Sheer khurma is made on Eid, so everyone comes to our house.
We used to make sheer khurma on Eid because it was very easy.
questions.correctAnswer: Sheer khurma was always made on Eid, but it is not the same any more.

questions.sentence: Ab ke baar itni der na kijiyega, phone kar liya kijiye.
options: Zaroor, ab main aksar phone karunga.
Maaf kijiye, mera phone kaam nahin karta.
Ji haan, aap ka number mere paas hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Zaroor, ab main aksar phone karunga.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, I will call often from now on.
